title: Haunted Mansion - The Curse of Blackwood Manor
intro: You awaken on the cold marble floor of Blackwood Manor. A violent thunderstorm rages outside, lightning flashing through cracked stained glass. The air is ice-cold, and distant whispers echo from the walls. You must break the mansion's curse before your sanity dissolves into the shadows...

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.description: A grand, decaying foyer with cracked mirrors, a grand pendulum clock frozen at 3:33 AM, and shadowy family portraits whose eyes seem to follow you.

items.name: Old Key
items.description: A heavy iron key carved with serpent runes. It looks like it unlocks the basement crypt.

items.name: Candle
items.description: A consecrated beeswax candle. Its pure flame can illuminate darkness and reveal hidden passages.

ghost.name: Whispering Shadow
ghost.description: A spectral silhouette drifting near the grand mirrors, murmuring warnings about the crypt below.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Towering mahogany bookshelves stretch into the darkness, holding centuries of forbidden occult tomes and dusty family journals.

items.name: Spellbook
items.description: An ancient grimoire bound in dark leather, detailing sacred exorcism verses to banish evil spirits.

ghost.name: Wraith of the Library
ghost.description: The tortured spirit of Lord Blackwood, obsessively guarding his dark research from intruders.

rooms.name: Conservatory
rooms.description: An overgrown Victorian greenhouse under a shattered glass dome. Withered black roses and thorny vines crawl over antique statues.

items.name: Silver Dagger
items.description: A finely forged silver blade engraved with protective runes, capable of dispelling aggressive wraiths.

items.name: Healing Tonic
items.description: An herbal restorative draught brewed from soothing mountain herbs (+40 Sanity).

rooms.name: Attic
rooms.description: A quiet, moonlit nursery filled with dusty rocking horses, vintage music boxes, and forgotten childhood memories.

ghost.name: Casper the Friendly Ghost
ghost.description: The innocent, glowing spirit of the young Blackwood heir, seeking someone with a kind heart.

rooms.name: Basement
rooms.description: A freezing stone crypt deep beneath the mansion foundations. In the center stands the ancient Obsidian Altar of Purification.

items.name: Amulet
items.description: A radiant silver talisman that wards off dark corruption and serves as the core key to the ritual altar.

ghost.name: Guardian of the Crypt
ghost.description: A demonic spectral warden bound to the altar to protect the ancient curse.
